intro: Yorus Barleybrew is an Alliance warrior summons directing seasoned fighters out of Stormwind toward the borderlands of Redridge. Issued by martial trainers across the Alliance capitals, it sends ambitious combatants to meet an eccentric dwarf laying down a deadly challenge at the Lakeshire Inn.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Yorus Barleybrew has issued a challenge to all able warriors of the Alliance. He waits at the Lakeshire Inn, in Redridge, and pledges a grand reward to anyone able to pass his trial.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Hah! So you heard of my challenge, did you?
Well sit down and listen. Have a drink, and savor it... Because it might be your last.
